value.rationale: Quantifies a natural non-universal Lucas-congruence phenomenon modulo a prime square: exact block frequency, explicit recurrence and nontrivial one-third density despite only three of six universally safe digit pairs. This measures genuine cancellation across adjacent digits, a structural invariant not supplied by fixed-residue counts.
